statement.summary: Lemma 4.2 (eq. (cr)) is frozen as `lemMobiusCrStatement` in Paper/S03_MobiusCoefficients.lean. Up to paper v7 it was the last part of Lemma 4.1, and the frozen conjunction `lemMobiusStatement` (frozen against v3.1) still joins it to the two Props of Lemma 4.1. c_r(p), lines, span J and rk J are literal project definitions in the same file.
deltas: span J = `Submodule.span` of the union of the lines in J; rk J = finrank (span J) (the paper defines rk J in Lemma 3.3 for order-p subgroups of 𝒜; the evident meaning is used for lines of 𝔽_p^d).
c_r(p) is `cr p d r` (explicit d); all sums and signs in ℤ.
[d r]_p = `gaussBinom p d r` (q-Pascal recurrence); agreement with the paper's product formula is `P01.gaussBinomProductFidelityStatement`.
0 ≤ r ≤ d: r : ℕ, `r ≤ d` kept as hypothesis. p prime and d ≥ 1 as in the paper (NeZero p derived from primality).

maps.label: p prime
maps.note: Prime p in all three Props. `NeZero p` (needed for the finiteness instances) is derived from hp by `haveI`, so it adds no hypothesis.

maps.label: d ≥ 1
maps.note: Kept verbatim although not needed (the claims hold for d = 0 too).

lean.text: cr p d r = (-1 : ℤ) ^ r * (p : ℤ) ^ (r.choose 2) * (gaussBinom p d r : ℤ)

maps.label: c_r(p) := Σ_{J ⊆ lines(𝔽_p^d), rk J = r} (−1)^{|J|}

lean.text:
∑ J ∈ (lines (⊤ : Submodule (ZMod p) (Fin d → ZMod p))).powerset.filter
      (fun J => rkJ J = r), (-1 : ℤ) ^ J.card

maps.note: `cr p d r` makes explicit the dependence on d that the paper's notation c_r(p) suppresses.

maps.label: J ⊆ lines(𝔽_p^d)
maps.note: lines(𝔽_p^d) = lines of the top subspace ⊤.

maps.label: rk J = dim span J

tex.text: where $\rk J$ is the dimension of the span of the corresponding lines

maps.note: rk J is defined in Lemma 3.3 for sets of order-p subgroups of 𝒜; for a set of lines of 𝔽_p^d the evident meaning dim span J is used (noted as a minor notation point in the S03 docstring).

maps.label: (−1)^r p^{C(r,2)} [d r]_p

lean.text: (-1 : ℤ) ^ r * (p : ℤ) ^ (r.choose 2) * (gaussBinom p d r : ℤ)

maps.note: Product in ℤ; the Gaussian binomial is cast from ℕ.

maps.label: [d r]_p (Gaussian binomial)

lean.text: | dd + 1, r + 1 => gaussBinom q dd r + q ^ (r + 1) * gaussBinom q dd (r + 1)

maps.note: Lean defines [d r]_q by the q-Pascal recurrence, the paper by the product formula (§3 preamble); their agreement for prime p, 0 ≤ r ≤ d is the separately frozen and proved fidelity Prop of group 01.

maps.label: 0 ≤ r ≤ d
maps.note: 0 ≤ r is automatic for r : ℕ; r ≤ d is kept (for r > d both sides are 0, which the paper does not claim).
